title: LADWP Rebates 2026: Heat Pumps, Windows, Insulation, EV Chargers
desc: What the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power pays in 2026: heat pump tiers, water heater $1,500 to $2,500, windows $2 per sq ft, attic insulation, EV charger up to $1,000.
badge: Heat pump up to $2,500 per ton
lead: LADWP is the city of Los Angeles's own utility and it runs a real rebate program, with amounts that depend on how efficient the equipment is. An older online claim of a flat $2,500 per ton is wrong. These are the 2026 figures from LADWP's pages.
cards_intro: LADWP's Consumer Rebate Program covers many products and funds are limited. We read its pages on October 2, 2026. Each card names the fact with the date and source link. Amounts depend on tier, so use the card as a guide and read LADWP's table before you buy.

cards.title: Heat pump heating and cooling
cards.note: Ducted $1,000 to $1,250 per ton and ductless $1,500 to $2,500 per ton by SEER2 and HSPF2 tier. Minimum 15.2 SEER2 and 7.7 HSPF2. From November 1, 2025.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: By tank size and UEF. Minimum UEF 3.3 and 30 gallons.

cards.title: Windows
cards.note: ENERGY STAR windows. LADWP does rebate windows, despite what some sites say.

cards.title: Attic insulation
cards.note: $0.50 per sq ft above R-19 and $0.30 at R-19 or below, plus a $0.25 launch special LADWP says was extended. Batt and roll only. Apply within 12 months.

cards.title: EV charger
cards.note: For a qualifying Level 2 charger, plus $500 for lifeline or EZ-SAVE customers and $250 for a dedicated EV meter.

cards.title: Smart thermostat and Power Savers
cards.note: Up to $100 back on an ENERGY STAR thermostat, and a $55 prepaid card plus up to $90 a year for joining the demand response season.

cards.title: Solar and storage equity funds
cards.note: LADWP administers the SGIP equity funds for households at or below 80% of area median income. There is no general LADWP battery rebate.

sections: LADWP supplies electricity in the City of Los Angeles. Glendale, Burbank and Pasadena run their own utilities, and Santa Monica and Long Beach buy from Southern California Edison, so a Los Angeles County address does not guarantee LADWP service. Check your bill. Our Burbank, Glendale and Pasadena pages cover those utilities.

Most LADWP rebates need a finaled building permit and an application within 12 months of purchase. New construction and accessory dwelling units are excluded. Funds are limited and first come, first served, so a rebate that is open today can close. Attic insulation rebates apply only to projects bought and installed on or after September 1, 2025, and only batt and roll insulation qualifies, not blown-in.

LADWP has no general cash rebate for solar batteries. Battery money is limited to the SGIP equity funds for households at or below 80% of area median income. State and federal programs add little in 2026: TECH Clean California and the federal home electrification rebates are reserved or paused, and the federal 25C and 25D credits ended after 2025.

Several LADWP programs can be used on one house, since each item has its own line. A heat pump, a water heater and attic insulation together can reach several thousand dollars. See our stacking guide for a worked example.
claim_heading: How to claim a LADWP rebate
claim_steps: Confirm your electric bill says LADWP.
Check the equipment tier and size in LADWP's rebate table before you buy.
Pull the permit and get it finaled for items that need one.
Apply within 12 months of purchase through LADWP's online portal, with receipts and the finaled permit.
Keep photos of the nameplate and the finished installation.

faq: Yes. ENERGY STAR windows pay $2.00 per square foot under the Consumer Rebate Program.
Is the heat pump rebate a flat $2,500 per ton?
No. It runs from $1,000 per ton to $2,500 per ton depending on whether the system is ducted or ductless and on its efficiency tier.
Does LADWP pay for solar batteries?
Only through SGIP equity funds for households at or below 80% of area median income.
For most items, yes. LADWP wants a finaled permit and an application within 12 months of purchase.
Can I use the rebate for an ADU?
No. New construction and accessory dwelling units are excluded.
